metadata.boundary: Executes Browser-Use's official Agent, Browser, prompts, history, actions, provider wrapper, and model loop from a bounded private git archive of the pinned commit. The resolved Git and Python identities are recorded and checked through the trial. It is distinct from the flat parallel-agents example study.
metadata.accounting: Upstream TokenCost entries are retained as incomplete lower bounds; provider pricing is intentionally not fetched.
metadata.workspace_owner: Browser-Use owns its browser and tools; do not add a Scaffold Lab browser environment.
